general_ui_ux_guidelines: Strictly dark mode UI: no harsh white cards or backgrounds.
Do NOT use pure transparent backgrounds for navbars, modals, or player control tooltips. Always use backdrop-blur with semi-opaque dark slate/obsidian (#0f0f14 with opacity).
Every interactive button, menu item, slider, and input MUST contain explicit hover/active states with visible contrast.
Custom video controls must feel weighted and responsive with zero latency on toggle.
Persist video watch time position to localStorage under 'synflix_continue_watching' and allow resume upon opening Synapse Player.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid for end-to-end automated testing.
